        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/building-from-scratch
        description: "My ongoing repo where I build language models and related concepts from first principles. I’ve worked through multiple sub-projects so far:"
        list:
          - Character-level GPT
          - GPT-2 124M reimplementation with RoPE
          - BPE tokenizer from scratch (with a Rust encoder for 3.7x speedup)
          - LLM inference with KV cache and speculative decoding
          - Supervised fine-tuning for reasoning and instruction following
          - Expert iteration for self-improvement on math
          - Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
        note: Currently working on a FlashAttention2 implementation from first principles.
      - title: cv-skills
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/cv-skills
        description: "I built this as a Claude Code plugin that provides multiple skills for classical image processing: format conversion, SVG-to-raster, resize/crop/rotate, color adjustments, blur/sharpen/denoise, edge detection and segmentation, and image compositing with background removal."
      - title: ComfyUI-Svg2Raster
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/ComfyUI-Svg2Raster
        description: "I wrote this ComfyUI custom node package for loading SVG files and rasterizing them into images with configurable width, scale, background color, and border. Uses CairoSVG under the hood."
      - title: tutorials
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/tutorials

      - title: spatial-alias-removal
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/spatial-alias-removal
        description: "I used deep learning super-resolution (SRCNN, EDSR, VDSR) to upscale seismic data by 2x in the spatial direction and remove spatial aliasing. This work was published as a paper back in 2019, built during my time at TU Delft and University of Amsterdam."
      - title: research-papers
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/research-papers
        description: "My reading notes and summaries for deep learning papers organized by category. Covers diffusion models (DDPM, DDIM, ControlNet, SDXL, and more), Transformers (Attention Is All You Need), and GANs."
      - title: pytorch-pl-hydra-templates
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/pytorch-pl-hydra-templates
        description: "I put together four progressively more sophisticated PyTorch training templates using CIFAR-10: vanilla single-GPU, multi-GPU with DistributedDataParallel, PyTorch Lightning with TensorBoard, and PyTorch Lightning + Hydra for rapid experimentation with swappable models, optimizers, and configs."
      - title: model-parallelism
        path: https://github.com/garg-aayush/model-parallelism
        description: "I explored how to pipeline models with skip connections (ResNets, UNets) across multiple GPUs using torchgpipe."
